style_suffix: Photorealistic, high detail, natural colour grading. No text, no watermark, no brand logos.

sim-road.prompt: Wide landscape photograph at a cyclist's eye level: an alpine mountain road curving towards snow-capped peaks, a calm lake on the left reflecting bright sunlight with strong sparkling glare on the water, wet asphalt with a bright sheen, low morning sun in the upper right with visible glare, a lone road cyclist in the middle distance, crisp summer morning.

goggle-mirror-dark.prompt: Studio product photograph of a high-wrap prescription sports goggle with a single shield lens, matte black frame, iridescent mirror lens coating shifting from cobalt blue to violet to gold, three-quarter view, on a deep midnight navy background, dramatic rim lighting, glossy reflections on the lens, premium eyewear advertising.

goggle-pop.prompt: Studio product photograph of a wraparound sports goggle with a white frame and an orange mirror shield lens, viewed from the front slightly above, on a flat solid light sky-blue background, hard graphic shadow, clean minimal advertising style.

sport-cycling.prompt: Medium close-up of a road cyclist in a helmet wearing high-wrap sports goggles, riding on a mountain road, morning light, slight motion blur in the background, sharp focus on the face and goggles.

sport-running.prompt: Trail runner wearing lightweight wraparound sport sunglasses, running along a grassy mountain ridge trail at sunrise, athletic, dynamic, sharp focus on runner.

sport-ski.prompt: Skier wearing ski goggles with a mirror lens and a helmet, carving on a bright snowy slope, snow spray, blue sky, sunlight.

sport-outdoor.prompt: Mountaineer wearing wraparound sport goggles on a rocky high-altitude ridge, wind and fine dust, dramatic clouds, rugged terrain.

sport-water.prompt: Angler on a small boat wearing polarized wraparound sport sunglasses, holding a fishing rod, open sea with bright sunlight glare on the water, late afternoon.

sport-precision.prompt: Golfer wearing sleek wraparound sport sunglasses, crouching to read the green before a putt, golf course, soft daylight, shallow depth of field.

factory-lab.prompt: Modern optical prescription lens laboratory with automated freeform surfacing and edging machines in rows, clean white and blue interior, a technician in a lab coat inspecting a lens against the light, industrial precision.

coating.prompt: Close-up inside an industrial high-vacuum optical coating chamber: a domed rack holding dozens of lenses with iridescent blue-violet-gold reflections, metallic surfaces, dramatic light.
